verdict.rationale: BILL provides a well-documented public v3 REST API (developer.bill.com) covering AP/AR/S&E resources, with concrete endpoints (POST /v3/vendors, PATCH /v3/vendors/{id}, bulk/mass payments), webhooks, sandbox environment, and even an llms.txt for AI discoverability. Missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec file was found (all probed paths 404), and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
